movelist.name: Submission
movelist.effect: On an accuracy roll of 15+, the target is Tripped.

movelist.name: Bulk Up
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Brick Break
movelist.effect: Light Screen and Reflect may not be activated in response to Brick Break.

movelist.name: Detect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Detect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Bind
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Paralysis. Defensive.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.effect: Moves with a Damage Base of 6 or lower have their Damage Base increased by +2. This bonus always applies to Moves with the Double Strike or Fivestrike Keywords.
